description: Price a Widely phone number for a country, including the monthly amount and whether local calls are included. Use this when a UK, US, Israeli, or other local number is needed. Each number includes 2 simultaneous calls. More come in packs of 10, shared by the account's numbers in the same country; channel_count prices the packs needed for a total such as 15. No sign-in. This does not purchase the number.

channel_count.description: Total simultaneous calls wanted, including the 2 included.

currency.description: GBP, EUR, USD, or ILS. Omit for the rate-checker default.
